capabilities: Render card-styled links as code blocks
Show local images through internal links
extras: Custom styling is done through CSS snippets rather than plugin settings; the README includes a YAML attribute reference and an example.
motivation: The author wanted to show beautiful links in notes without cluttering Markdown files with HTML tags.
problem: Plain URLs in notes lack titles, descriptions, and previews, and HTML-based embeds mess up Markdown files.
summary: Link enhancer that fetches a URL's metadata and renders it as a card-styled link via a code block.
